package newspipe.infrastructure.env

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}
import scala.annotation.tailrec
import scala.collection.mutable

final case class DotEnv(values: Map[String, String], source: Option[Path]):
  def get(key: String): Option[String] = values.get(key)
  def keys: Set[String] = values.keySet

object DotEnv:
  private val MaxDepth = 10

  def empty: DotEnv = DotEnv(Map.empty, None)

  def discover(start: Path): DotEnv =
    @tailrec def walk(dir: Path): DotEnv =
      if dir == null then empty
      else
        val candidate: Path = dir.resolve(".env")
        if Files.isRegularFile(candidate) then
          val text: String = Files.readString(candidate, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
          DotEnv(expand(parse(text)).fold(m => Map.empty, identity), Some(candidate))
        else walk(dir.getParent)
    walk(start.toAbsolutePath.normalize())

  private def parse(text: String): Map[String, String] =
    val acc: mutable.Map[String, String] = mutable.Map.empty
    text.linesIterator.foreach: line =>
      val trimmed: String = line.trim
      if trimmed.nonEmpty && !trimmed.startsWith("#") then
        val idx: Int = trimmed.indexOf('=')
        if idx > 0 then
          acc.update(trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim, unquote(trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim))
    acc.toMap

  private def unquote(raw: String): String =
    val quoted: Boolean = raw.length >= 2 &&
      ((raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'")) || (raw.startsWith("\"") && raw.endsWith("\"")))
    if quoted then raw.substring(1, raw.length - 1) else raw

  def expand(raw: Map[String, String]): Either[String, Map[String, String]] =
    val out: mutable.Map[String, String] = mutable.Map.empty
    val keys: List[String] = raw.keys.toList.sorted
    keys.foreach: key =>
      resolve(key, raw, 0, Nil) match
        case Right(v) => out.update(key, v)
        case Left(e) => return Left(e)
    Right(out.toMap)

  private def resolve(key: String, raw: Map[String, String], depth: Int, seen: List[String]): Either[String, String] =
    if depth > MaxDepth then Left(s"expansion depth exceeded resolving '$key'")
    else if seen.contains(key) then Left(s"circular reference: ${(seen :+ key).mkString(" -> ")}")
    else
      raw.get(key) match
        case None => Right("")
        case Some(v) => substitute(v, raw, depth + 1, seen :+ key)

  private def substitute(text: String, raw: Map[String, String], depth: Int, seen: List[String]): Either[String, String] =
    val out: StringBuilder = StringBuilder.newBuilder
    var idx: Int = 0
    while idx < text.length do
      text.charAt(idx) match
        case '$' if idx + 1 < text.length && text.charAt(idx + 1) == '{' =>
          val close: Int = text.indexOf('}', idx + 2)
          if close < 0 then
            out.append(text.substring(idx))
            idx = text.length
          else
            resolve(text.substring(idx + 2, close), raw, depth, seen) match
              case Right(v) => out.append(v)
              case Left(e) => return Left(e)
            idx = close + 1
        case c =>
          out.append(c)
          idx = idx + 1
    Right(out.result())

package newspipe

import newspipe.infrastructure.env.DotEnv
import org.scalatest.funspec.AnyFunSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}
import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

class DotEnvSpec extends AnyFunSpec with Matchers:
  private def chain(depth: Int): Path =
    val root: Path = Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-chain")
    (0 until depth).foldLeft(root)((acc, _) => Files.createDirectories(acc.resolve("a")))
    root

  private def write(dir: Path, body: String): Path =
    val f: Path = dir.resolve(".env")
    Files.writeString(f, body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
    f

  describe("DotEnv.discover") {
    it("returns an empty map when no .env exists on the path to the root") {
      DotEnv.discover(Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-none")).values shouldBe empty
      DotEnv.discover(Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-none")).source shouldBe None
    }
    it("returns the first .env found walking upward") {
      val root: Path = chain(3)
      write(root.resolve("a").resolve("a"), "NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET=from-top\n")
      write(root.resolve("a"), "NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET=from-middle\n")
      val found: DotEnv = DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a").resolve("a"))
      found.get("NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET") shouldBe Some("from-top")
      found.source.map(_.getFileName.toString) shouldBe Some(".env")
    }
    it("prefers the nearest .env over one further up") {
      val root: Path = chain(2)
      write(root.resolve("a"), "K=upper\n")
      write(root, "K=nearest\n")
      DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a")).get("K") shouldBe Some("nearest")
    }
  }

  describe("DotEnv.expand") {
    it("expands a bare value") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "plain")).toOption.get("A") shouldBe Some("plain")
    }
    it("expands a reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "x", "B" -> "${A}y")).toOption.get("B") shouldBe Some("xy")
    }
    it("expands a nested reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "1", "B" -> "${A}", "C" -> "${B}${A}")).toOption.get("C") shouldBe Some("11")
    }
    it("treats a self reference as a hard error") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "${A}")).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
    it("treats a circular reference as a hard error") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "${B}", "B" -> "${A}")).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
    it("bounds expansion depth at ten") {
      val deep: Map[String, String] = (0 to 12).map(i => s"V$i" -> s"${if i == 12 then "end" else s"V${i + 1}"}").toMap
      DotEnv.expand(deep).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
  }

  describe("quoting") {
    it("keeps a single-quoted value literal") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "'${A}'")).toOption.get("A") shouldBe Some("${A}")
    }
    it("expands a double-quoted value") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "1", "B" -> "\"${A}\"")).toOption.get("B") shouldBe Some("${A}")
    }
    it("leaves an unquoted value alone when it has no reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "plain")).toOption.get("A") shouldBe Some("plain")
    }
  }

package newspipe.infrastructure.env

import com.typesafe.config.{Config, ConfigFactory}

import java.nio.file.Paths
import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

final case class EnvConfig(
    feeds: List[String],
    pollIntervalSeconds: Long,
    kafkaBootstrap: String,
    rawTopic: String,
    bronzePath: String,
    sparkMaster: String,
    s3Endpoint: String,
    s3PathStyle: Boolean,
    s3AccessKey: String,
    s3SecretKey: String,
    s3Bucket: String
)

object Env:
  private val EnvFileName = ".env"

  def load(): EnvConfig =
    load(ConfigFactory.load().getConfig("newspipe"), DotEnv.discover(Paths.get("").toAbsolutePath))

  def load(cfg: Config): EnvConfig =
    load(cfg, DotEnv.discover(Paths.get("").toAbsolutePath))

  def load(cfg: Config, dot: DotEnv): EnvConfig =
    def pick(key: String, fallback: => String): String =
      sys.env.get(key).orElse(dot.get(key)).getOrElse(fallback)
    def pickLong(key: String, fallback: => Long): Long =
      sys.env.get(key).map(_.toLong).orElse(dot.get(key).map(_.toLong)).getOrElse(fallback)
    def pickBool(key: String, fallback: => Boolean): Boolean =
      sys.env.get(key).map(_.toBoolean).orElse(dot.get(key).map(_.toBoolean)).getOrElse(fallback)

    EnvConfig(
      feeds = pick("NEWSPIPE_FEEDS", cfg.getStringList("feeds").asScala.mkString(","))
        .split(",").toList.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty),
      pollIntervalSeconds = pickLong("NEWSPIPE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS", cfg.getLong("poll-interval-seconds")),
      kafkaBootstrap = pick("NEWSPIPE_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP", cfg.getString("kafka.bootstrap-servers")),
      rawTopic = pick("NEWSPIPE_RAW_TOPIC", cfg.getString("kafka.raw-topic")),
      bronzePath = pick("NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_PATH", cfg.getString("bronze.path")),
      sparkMaster = pick("NEWSPIPE_SPARK_MASTER", cfg.getString("spark.master")),
      s3Endpoint = pick("NEWSPIPE_S3_ENDPOINT", cfg.getString("s3.endpoint")),
      s3PathStyle = pickBool("NEWSPIPE_S3_PATH_STYLE", cfg.getBoolean("s3.path-style-access")),
      s3AccessKey = pick("NEWSPIPE_S3_ACCESS_KEY", cfg.getString("s3.access-key")),

package newspipe.infrastructure.messagequeue

import newspipe.application.ports.{KafkaReadinessProbe, ProbeResult}

import java.net.{InetSocketAddress, Socket}
import scala.util.Try

final class TcpKafkaReadinessProbe(bootstrap: String, timeoutMillis: Int) extends KafkaReadinessProbe:
  def name: String = "kafka"

  def check(): ProbeResult =
    val endpoints: List[String] = bootstrap.split(",").toList.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty)
    if endpoints.isEmpty then ProbeResult.NotReady(name, "no bootstrap server configured")
    else
      val results: List[Either[String, String]] = endpoints.map(reachable)
      results.collectFirst { case Left(detail) => detail } match
        case Some(detail) => ProbeResult.NotReady(name, detail)
        case None => ProbeResult.Ready

  private def reachable(endpoint: String): Either[String, String] =
    val idx: Int = endpoint.lastIndexOf(':')
    if idx <= 0 then Left(s"malformed bootstrap '$endpoint'")
    else
      val host: String = endpoint.substring(0, idx)
      val port: Int = Try(endpoint.substring(idx + 1).toInt).getOrElse(-1)
      if port <= 0 then Left(s"malformed port in '$endpoint'")
      else
        Try:
          val socket: Socket = new Socket()
          try socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), timeoutMillis)
          finally socket.close()
          Right(endpoint)
        .toEither.left.map(_ => s"cannot reach $endpoint")

          case ProbeResult.Ready => Nil
          case ProbeResult.NotReady(dep, detail) => List(s"$dep: $detail")
      if last.isEmpty then continue = false

package newspipe.infrastructure.kafka

import newspipe.application.ports.{KafkaReadinessProbe, ProbeResult}

import java.net.{InetSocketAddress, Socket}
import scala.util.Try

final class TcpKafkaReadinessProbe(bootstrap: String, timeoutMillis: Int) extends KafkaReadinessProbe:
  def name: String = "kafka"

  def check(): ProbeResult =
    val endpoints: List[String] = bootstrap.split(",").toList.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty)
    if endpoints.isEmpty then ProbeResult.NotReady(name, "no bootstrap server configured")
    else
      val results: List[Either[String, String]] = endpoints.map(reachable)
      results.collectFirst { case Left(detail) => detail } match
        case Some(detail) => ProbeResult.NotReady(name, detail)
        case None => ProbeResult.Ready

  private def reachable(endpoint: String): Either[String, String] =
    val idx: Int = endpoint.lastIndexOf(':')
    if idx <= 0 then Left(s"malformed bootstrap '$endpoint'")
    else
      val host: String = endpoint.substring(0, idx)
      val port: Int = Try(endpoint.substring(idx + 1).toInt).getOrElse(-1)
      if port <= 0 then Left(s"malformed port in '$endpoint'")
      else
        Try:
          val socket: Socket = new Socket()
          try socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), timeoutMillis)
          finally socket.close()
          Right(endpoint)
        .toEither.left.map(_ => s"cannot reach $endpoint")
